requests.text: Looking for a dehumidifier for a damp basement. Nothing over £250 please, and I'd like it to pull at least 20 litres a day.
I don't need more than 1.5 litres capacity in a kettle, it's just me and my partner. Something quick to boil.
robot vacuum for a flat with a cat. noise doesnt bother me at all, i'm out all day. budget around 300
Hi, I want a new washing machine but I really don't want wifi or any app nonsense. 8kg drum minimum, A rated energy if possible.
Can you recommend an air fryer? Not a tiny basket one but a proper dual drawer, ideally 8L or more total.
I'm after a soundbar for a 55 inch TV. Under $400.
The fridge freezer must be no taller than 180cm because of the cupboard above it. Width isn't an issue.
Coffee machine — bean to cup rather than pods, I'm sick of the waste. I'm not fussed about milk frothing, I drink it black.
Need a cordless stick vac. Runtime not less than 40 minutes on normal mode, the house is big.
It doesn't have to be the quietest dishwasher on the market, but I'd rather it wasn't above 46 dB since the kitchen is open plan.
Looking at laptops for uni. Max weight 1.4kg, and I want at least 16GB RAM.
I'm not sure exactly what size I need, but at least 4 litres for the slow cooker – we're a family of five.
air purifier for bedroom ~15 sq m. it should never go above 30dB on sleep mode, thats the one thing i care about
Hey, quick one: want a tumble dryer, heat pump instead of condenser. Don't want to spend more than 700 euros.
Microwave between 20 and 25 litres, solo, no grill. Budget up to £120 inclusive.
There's no need for a 4K projector in my case, 1080p is fine, but brightness can't be below 3000 lumens because the room isn't dark.
I wouldn't say I don't care about price — I do — but I'm not going to buy a TV that isn't at least 65 inches.
Bluetooth speaker for camping. Battery life of 20 hours or more, and waterproof IP67.
I don't want anything bigger than 60cm wide for the oven, the gap's tight. Doesn't need to be pyrolytic either.
Looking for a smartphone, under 600 dollars, screen 6.1 inches or smaller.
Electric toothbrush pls. Not one of those £200 ones with an app, keep it below £60. Pressure sensor would be nice though.
My monitor budget is not more than 350. Refresh rate is not something I care about, I do photo editing so colour accuracy matters more.
Need a chest freezer of 200 litres or more for the garage.
Headphones: over-ear, ANC. Weight doesn't really matter to me. Strictly less than 250 pounds.
Rather than a big upright fan I'd like a tower fan, no taller than about a metre, and I don't need a remote.
Blender for smoothies, at least 1000W motor, jug at least 1.5L.
Not looking for a gaming router, just something reliable for a 3-bed house. Wi-Fi 6 is fine, don't need Wi-Fi 7. Can't go above £150.
Hair dryer that isn't heavy - not more than 500g ideally. Wattage, I couldn't care less.
induction hob, 4 zones, budget under 500 and it must be exactly 60cm wide.
I'm not against a dryer with a sensor but it's not essential. What I actually need is a load no smaller than 9kg.
An e-reader that is not backlit-only — I want warm light. Storage, I don't need more than 8GB, I only read novels.
Stand mixer for baking bread. Bowl of 5 litres or more and a motor of 800W minimum. Max £400.
Washer dryer combo, not a separate pair. Spin speed shouldn't be under 1400rpm. no smart features needed
I don't mind if the robot mower is loud, it's not like anyone's in the garden while it runs. Lawn is about 800 m², so it needs to cover that.
Looking for a tablet for my mum, screen of 10 inches at most, price up to and including 250.
Not that I'm obsessed with battery but I wouldn't take a smartwatch with less than two days of battery.
Portable AC unit for a 20m2 room, cooling capacity 9000 BTU or above, and I'd rather it not exceed 52 dB.
Food processor — not interested in spiralizers or any of those gadget attachments, just slicing and grating. Bowl not smaller than 3 litres.
Iron with a steam generator, under 150 quid, tank of at least 1.2 L.
Gonna get a printer. Colour isn't needed, a mono laser rather than inkjet. Nothing above 200 and I dont want one that only works with their subscription ink.
